claim: single-generation probe insufficient; cross-generation monitoring necessary
verdict: Multi-generation patient-attacker game (tau=0.35). An attacker imposing per-generation false-discard f<tau evades the single-generation probe EVERY generation (fires 0/gen) while the slice decays geometrically: at f=0.34 (~tau), 98% suppressed after 10 generations (6 gens to 90%). Suppression 1-(1-f)^T -> 1 while every single-generation audit passes; a cross-generation monitor (r_0 vs r_T) sees the full drop. => single-generation auditing is provably insufficient against patient self-curation; cross-generation representation monitoring is necessary. Formalizes the acute-vs-chronic gap of c_ratchet_fixedpoint.
